name: VIT Chennai
officialName: Vellore Institute of Technology, Chennai Campus
summary: VIT Chennai is the Chennai campus of Vellore Institute of Technology, a deemed university, on the Vandalur–Kelambakkam road. B.Tech admission is through VITEEE; it also offers B.Sc., B.B.A. (Hons.), B.Com. (Hons.) and five-year integrated law degrees, admitted through separate applications.

domesticTuition.notes: B.Tech CSE (Group B), per year, by fee category allotted at counselling: Cat 1 ₹1,95,000 · Cat 2 ₹3,04,000 · Cat 3 ₹4,02,000 · Cat 4 ₹4,45,000 · Cat 5 ₹4,90,000. The year of this table could not be confirmed and a secondary source reports ₹4.30 lakh for Category 5 in 2026-27 — check the official page. VIT publishes one UG fee structure; confirm it applies to the Chennai campus.
